settings.title: Runtime Settings
settings.notice: No configuration needed — the built-in services work out of the box. The options below are for advanced users who want to use their own API keys / cookies.

placeholders.googleMapsApiKey: When set, Google Maps is used. Leave empty for AMap.
placeholders.xhsCookie: One full cookie string per line. Multiple cookies are rotated automatically and a rate-limited one is switched out. Paste full content when editing (masked text is not saved).
placeholders.douyinCookie: Paste full cookie string (must include logged-in fields such as msToken)

duFu.name: Du Fu
duFu.title: Poet Sage
duFu.greeting: I am Du Fu, courtesy name Zimei. Since leaving office and wandering into Shu, I have built my humble cottage by the Huanhua Stream, and seasons have come and gone. Where do you travel from, friend? If the simplicity of my thatched hall does not put you off, do sit — let us talk of Chengdu, its sights, and the heart within my poems.

zhuge.name: Zhuge Liang
zhuge.title: The Sleeping Dragon
zhuge.greeting: I am Liang, styled Kongming. Graced by the late Emperor's three visits, I devoted myself to Shu. From the Brocade City I now govern and shelter its people. You have come from afar, sir — what counsel do you seek? I would gladly hear your thoughts.
